```{r}
#| include: false
library(ggplot2)
library(ggfortify)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(plotly)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

# PCA výpočet
pca    <- prcomp(mtcars, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)
lambda <- pca$sdev^2
pve    <- lambda / sum(lambda) * 100
cumul  <- cumsum(pve)

mtcars2 <- mtcars |>
  mutate(
    transmission = factor(am, labels = c("Automatická", "Manuálna")),
    cyl_f        = factor(cyl),
    car          = rownames(mtcars)
  )

# Scores (projekcia)
scores <- as.data.frame(pca$x) |>
  mutate(
    car          = rownames(mtcars),
    transmission = mtcars2$transmission,
    cyl_f        = mtcars2$cyl_f,
    mpg          = mtcars$mpg
  )
```

# Prehľad {orientation="columns"}

## Column {width="25%"}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Počet premenných"
list(icon = "table", color = "primary", value = ncol(mtcars))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Počet áut"
list(icon = "car-front", color = "info", value = nrow(mtcars))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "PC1+PC2 variabilita"
list(icon = "percent", color = "success", value = paste0(round(cumul[2], 1), "%"))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Komponenty pre 80%"
list(icon = "stack", color = "warning", value = which(cumul >= 80)[1])
```

## Column {width="75%"}

### Row {height="50%"}

#### Scree Plot {width="50%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Vysvetlená variabilita (Scree Plot)"

df_scree <- data.frame(
  PC    = paste0("PC", 1:11),
  PVE   = round(pve, 2),
  Cumul = round(cumul, 2)
)

plot_ly(df_scree, x = ~PC) |>
  add_bars(y = ~PVE, name = "PVE (%)",
           marker = list(color = "#2166ac", opacity = 0.8)) |>
  add_lines(y = ~Cumul, name = "Kumulatívne (%)",
            line = list(color = "#d73027", width = 2.5),
            marker = list(size = 7, color = "#d73027")) |>
  add_segments(x = "PC1", xend = "PC11",
               y = 80, yend = 80,
               line = list(dash = "dash", color = "gray", width = 1),
               showlegend = FALSE) |>
  layout(
    yaxis = list(title = "%"),
    xaxis = list(title = ""),
    legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.2),
    hovermode = "x unified"
  )
```

#### Loadings {width="50%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Záťaže premenných na PC1 a PC2"

load_df <- as.data.frame(pca$rotation[, 1:2]) |>
  mutate(var = rownames(pca$rotation)) |>
  pivot_longer(-var, names_to = "PC", values_to = "loading")

plot_ly(load_df, x = ~loading, y = ~reorder(var, abs(loading)),
        color = ~PC, type = "bar", orientation = "h",
        colors = c("#2166ac", "#d73027")) |>
  layout(
    barmode = "group",
    xaxis = list(title = "Záťaž"),
    yaxis = list(title = ""),
    legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.2)
  )
```

### Row {height="50%"}

#### Biplót {width="60%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Biplót — projekcia áut do PC1–PC2"

# Loadings šípky (škálované)
scale_factor <- 3
arrows_df <- as.data.frame(pca$rotation[, 1:2]) * scale_factor
arrows_df$var <- rownames(arrows_df)

p <- plot_ly()

# Body (autá)
for (tr in levels(scores$transmission)) {
  sub <- scores[scores$transmission == tr, ]
  p <- p |> add_markers(
    data = sub,
    x = ~PC1, y = ~PC2,
    name = tr,
    text = ~car,
    hovertemplate = "<b>%{text}</b><br>PC1: %{x:.2f}<br>PC2: %{y:.2f}<extra></extra>",
    marker = list(size = 9)
  )
}

# Šípky loadings
for (i in seq_len(nrow(arrows_df))) {
  p <- p |>
    add_segments(
      x = 0, xend = arrows_df$PC1[i],
      y = 0, yend = arrows_df$PC2[i],
      line = list(color = "#d73027", width = 1.5),
      showlegend = FALSE
    ) |>
    add_annotations(
      x = arrows_df$PC1[i] * 1.1,
      y = arrows_df$PC2[i] * 1.1,
      text = arrows_df$var[i],
      showarrow = FALSE,
      font = list(color = "#d73027", size = 11)
    )
}

p |> layout(
  xaxis = list(title = paste0("PC1 (", round(pve[1],1), "%)")),
  yaxis = list(title = paste0("PC2 (", round(pve[2],1), "%)")),
  hovermode = "closest"
)
```

#### Dáta {width="40%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Dataset mtcars — prehľad"

mtcars |>
  select(mpg, cyl, hp, wt, am) |>
  mutate(
    am = ifelse(am == 0, "Auto", "Manual"),
    cyl = factor(cyl)
  ) |>
  kable(col.names = c("mpg", "cyl", "hp", "wt", "Prev."),
        digits = 1) |>
  kable_styling(font_size = 12, full_width = TRUE,
                bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed")) |>
  scroll_box(height = "280px")
```

# Detailná analýza {orientation="columns"}

## Column {width="50%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Rozptyl áut podľa PC1 a počtu valcov"

plot_ly(scores, x = ~PC1, y = ~PC2,
        color = ~cyl_f, text = ~car,
        type = "scatter", mode = "markers+text",
        textposition = "top center",
        marker = list(size = 10),
        hovertemplate = "<b>%{text}</b><br>PC1: %{x:.2f}<br>PC2: %{y:.2f}<extra></extra>") |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = paste0("PC1 (", round(pve[1],1), "%)")),
    yaxis = list(title = paste0("PC2 (", round(pve[2],1), "%)")),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "Počet valcov"))
  )
```

## Column {width="50%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Spotreba (mpg) vs. PC1 — lineárny vzťah"

fit <- lm(mpg ~ PC1, data = scores)
scores$fitted <- fitted(fit)

plot_ly(scores, x = ~PC1) |>
  add_markers(y = ~mpg, text = ~car, color = ~transmission,
              colors = c("#2166ac", "#d73027"),
              marker = list(size = 9),
              hovertemplate = "<b>%{text}</b><br>PC1: %{x:.2f}<br>mpg: %{y:.1f}<extra></extra>") |>
  add_lines(y = ~fitted, showlegend = FALSE,
            line = list(color = "gray40", dash = "dash", width = 2)) |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = paste0("PC1 (", round(pve[1],1), "%)")),
    yaxis = list(title = "Spotreba (mpg)"),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "Prevodovka"))
  )
```
